_about: All values extracted verbatim from Chicago Community Areas_2026_SFF_Indicators_04022026.xlsx. Every block lists its sheet + table. No synthetic values: fields that the dataset does not cover are null and the UI must label their defaults as user assumptions.

salePrices2024._source: E.Property_Sales — tables 8 (row 124), 11 (row 170), 14 (row 216): median sales prices, North Lawndale, full-year 2024 (2025 column covers only the first half)

salesCounts2024._source: E.Property_Sales — tables 7 (row 109), 10 (row 155), 13 (row 201): number of sales, North Lawndale, 2024

taxBillsTY2023._source: B.Taxpayer_Characteristics — table 1 (row 18) single family, table 2 (row 33) 2-to-4 unit: median tax bill, North Lawndale, Tax Year 2023. The dataset has no condo tax-bill table.

taxBillsTY2012._source: B.Taxpayer_Characteristics — tables 1 and 2, TY2012 column (context: NL bills FELL 27.5% / 28.7% from 2012 to 2023)

exemptions2023._source: B.Taxpayer_Characteristics — tables 3 (row 49) and 4 (row 65): share of taxpayers with exemptions, North Lawndale, TY2023

incomes2024._source: A.Demographic_Socioeconomic — section 5 (rows 83, 88): median household income, 2024, rounded to nearest dollar

households2024._source: A.Demographic_Socioeconomic — section 4 (row 67) income composition, section 7 (row 116) tenure, 2024

hmda._source: G.Mortgage_Lending — table 1 (row 19) loan counts + median property value; tables 4/5 (rows 67, 83) borrower income mix; tables 2/3 (rows 35, 51) borrower race/ethnicity, North Lawndale. First-lien, owner-occupied, 1-to-4 unit home purchase loans (HMDA).
